scope: Read-only review of held child activation recovery checkpoints

blockers.contract: Public attachment helper accepts ordinary boundary/publication parts and attests their digests without authoritative journal admission verification
blockers.required_proof: Unadmitted and mismatched boundary/publication produce no attestation; public path retains opaque verified authority

blockers.contract: Service-taking activation routes bypass durable plan binding and permit host, stream, or issuer substitution
blockers.required_proof: Changed issuer, stream, and host are refused before publication or dispatch

blockers.contract: Process-local task gate does not fence two independently opened swarms dispatching the same activating child
blockers.required_proof: Durable exact-request owner claim; concurrent recovery produces one provider call and one terminal publication

blockers.contract: Existing root recovery tests do not exercise the new recover_activation path or recursive restart
blockers.required_proof: Direct activation recovery, authority swaps, publication crash windows, concurrent recovery, and recursive restart tests

boundaries: Held worker source is not integrated into the root branch
Reported root-session recovery passes do not qualify child activation
Strict recursive composition mismatch remains a separate required failure
All findings were assigned to the owning fork worker; no contract is waived
